keySentence: Alice fell down a deep hole into a strange world.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Alice found a small door. She drank something and got small. She entered a strange world. Alice fell down a deep hole into a strange world.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Alice saw a beautiful garden through a tiny door but was too big. She found a bottle on the table that said Drink Me on it. She drank it and her body shrank down to just ten inches tall. Alice fell down a deep hole into a strange world full of wonders. Everything in this new place followed different rules entirely. Alice did not know what would happen to her next.
facts.Word cards: strange = 이상한 / world = 세계 / hole = 구멍 / magical = 신기한 / Wonderland = 이상한 나라
